content: JESUS, ONIG LAA NAI, NUG DANAB BEUM
Kayak Nug keeke oh dig ma heum, haen amu ii nak amu Kristus, Nug onig laa Nai, Nug dayom. Nug Kayak noobp̱a dayom amge anamib iiṯa, Nug ele Kayak dayom.
A oh daapiḏ amu Kayak Nug keeke heḵunu dig ma,
Nug keeke oh Kristus ep̱egp̱a me heum. Keeke laa ib laap̱a ii beum.
Jesus Nug am bauklel hanhannu diig. Bauklel amuam danab oh dilag amahlak.
Amahalak amu Nug gatatup̱a amahalṯe amu gatatu nug amahlak amu eḏidḵunu elele iiṯa.
Kayak Nug danab laa nug danab ah amelagp̱a nai mehuqḵunu epeḏie doum. Danab amu onig Johanes. Nug amahlaknu nai mehuqebeb, danab ah oh ag nuhig mehuqak amup̱a oolagp̱a genab dooglagnu ahom.
Nug am amahlak amu iiṯa amge nug amahlak amunu mehuqḵunu ahom.
Amahlak amuam amahlak genab. Nug wanp̱a uḏia amu danab ah oh amahlak madaṯe.
Ao, Kristus, onig laa Nai, nug wanp̱a dayom, wan imu amu Nug he beum amge wanp̱anu danab ah ag Nug ii doop̱ig.
Nug keeke heump̱a na dayom amge danab ag Nug ḏo ii meṯan ii aop̱ig.
Amge laala ag Kristus aop̱ig amu ag aaḵu Kayak beḵod daaglagnu g̱agaṯag maṯom.
Ag tiig maḵulakp̱a amu beḏunu kobolp̱a, o danabnu dab makp̱a, ag Kayak beḵod ii bep̱ig. Iiṯa! Kayak Nug he, ag Nug beḵod bep̱ig.

Am Kristus, onig laa Nai, Nug danab beḏu awa, ig oonigp̱a dayom. Nug am Kayak beḵa laip̱unab amunu nuhig binag oḵai ele dayeye, ig Nug binag amu oḵai anidmut. Amu genabnu diig amu ehaniṯak oḵai hamu meṯak kobol ele amuam nuhigp̱a am baknab ele daaṯe.

Amu Johanes nug nuhignu nai mehuqaqa ewa aum. “Da anuḵa nuhignu maṯimi ele amu aaḵu. Da ami. ‘Nug da dim lamiḏa uḏiṯe, Nug am da eḏilak. Aḏinu? Da ii daami haenp̱a amu, Nug haen amup̱a ele dayom,’” awa aum.
Keeke ena oh amu nuhigp̱a am bak daaṯe amunu ig nuhigp̱a ehaniṯak diigdiig aaḵu aomut.
Yo, ḏo amu ig Moses nuhigp̱a aomut amge ehaniṯak oḵai hamu meṯak kobol am keeke genab ele amu ig Kristus nuhigp̱a aomut.
Danab laip̱u laa nug haen laa Kayak ii anṯom. Iiṯanab. Kayak Beḵa laip̱unab, Nug Kayak ele ou qak daaṯep amu, Nug aaḵuib aniṯa doya, Kayak ip̱uniḵom.
JOHANES UḎAT DIG MEUM
Aria deḏ laa Juda oḵai ag mana meṯak danab amu Lewi buḏub danab laa ele Jerusalem ap̱anu Johanes nuḵa nuhignu oḏ meṯaglagnu maaṯeg gona, “Na am aun?” ana oḏ meṯaeg,
Johanes nug ag amelagp̱a, “Da am Kristus iiṯa,” aḵunu ii uuom. Iiṯa, nug miag nai mehuqaqa, “Da am Kristus iiṯa,” awa aum.

Anam a amu ag ap̱ig. “Anam daaṯe dayeb amu na am aun? Na am Eliaste?” aon ap̱ig. Aeg amu nug aum. “Da am nug iiṯa.” Nug anam a amu ag ap̱ig. “Ge na nug iiṯa daaṯem dayeb amu na am propet laa uḏiḵunu, ig nug ameg meṯem ele amute?” aon ap̱ig. Ag anam aeg amu nug, “Iiṯa,” awa aum.
Anam a amu ag ap̱ig. “Ehe! Ig danab meiḵeg uḏimut ele amu ahilag oḏ mak nob eḏugnignu am na naḵa nahipnu amu aḏinab aṯem?” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aeg amu Johanes nug inam aum. “Da amu, baag laa propet Jesaia aum bia, atu taḏakp̱a, ‘Ag oolagp̱a Naḏinu ib babaiṯeg!’ awa eṯe,” awa aum.

Anam daye amu maaṯeg uḏip̱ig ele amu ag oolagp̱anu laala ag ḏo gumak danab-Parasia daap̱ig amu ag Johanes oḏ meṯan ap̱ig. “Na Kristus iiṯa, Elias iiṯa amu propet ele iiṯa. Anam dayeb amu na aḏinu danab ah layadṯem?”
Ag anam aeg amu Johanes amelagp̱a aum. “Da amu ag lep̱a layadṯem amge ag oolagp̱a ap̱a laa hibaiṯom daaṯe ele amu ag Nug ii dooṯeb.
Danab amu Nug da dimulp̱a uḏiṯe amge dahil hak amu nuhig ele, elele iiṯa, Nug am da eḏilak,” awa aum.
Johanes nug Jodan lep̱a danab layaṯeṯe, keeke imu oh amu Beṯani ap̱a beum. Beṯani amu Jodan le laih ap̱a dayom.
JOHANES KAYAKNU SIPSIP NAG IP̱UANAṮOM
Wagḵaḏe deḏ amup̱a Jesus Nug Johanes gumiṯa uḏieye, Johanes Nug anṯa aum. “Anṯeg, Kayaknu Sipsip Nag, Nug wanp̱an danab dilag hip̱unin uhuqṯe ele amu, Nug am uuḵu.
Am danab umu aaḵuib da nuhignu inam ami. ‘Danab Nug da dimulp̱a uḏiṯe ele amu, Nug da eḏilak. Aḏinu? Nug anuḵanab da ii daami haenp̱a ele, Nug dayom.’
Laa ele, Nug Kayaknu sipsip nag daaḵunu matu ii doomi amge da Israel danab Kayaknu Sipsip Nag ip̱uanadḵulnu uḏien, danab ah lep̱a layadṯem,” awa aum.
Johanes anam anana amu nug nai tuḏiṯa aum. “Da Kayak Ouḏi Nug hab aṯannu, ai up̱uḏil bia na, Nug qaḏep̱a dayeye anidmi.

Da ele Nug ii doolom amge laa Nug da danab ah lep̱a layadḵulnu meiḏe uḏimi ele amu, Nug a doomi. Nug aum. ‘Kayak Ouḏi Nug na, danab laa qaḏep̱a daaḵu amu danab amu aaḵuib Nug geha Kayak Ouḏip̱a layadḵu,’ awa aum.
Amu da anidmi, nuhignu da madiṯem ele amu, Nug am Kayak beḵa.” Johanes anam aum.
JESUS IP̱UNIṮAK AWAK DANAB DIG MA DIIOM
Aria deḏ amu uue wagḵaḏe, deḏ amup̱a Johanes nug baula ap̱a dayeye, nuhig ip̱uniṯak awak danab aḏit ele daap̱ig.
Ag anam daanna, nug Jesus oieye anṯa aum. “Anṯeḏ! Umu am Kayaknu Sipsip Nag,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu ip̱uniṯak danab aḏit a Johanes nai aum amu a dooya, a Jesus dim lamiṯeheh,
Jesus Nug eḏua anata, Nug aum. “A aḏi madiṯep?” awa aum. Nug anam a amu a apiḏ. “Rabi na adep̱a daaṯem?” aoi apiḏ. Rabi eḏuak am ip̱uniṯak danab.

Aeh amu Nug aum. “A doya, da daaṯem aben anṯeḏ!” Nug anam a amu a Nug dim lamiṯeh gona, Nug daaṯe aben amu anidpiḏ. A Nug ele oh gop̱ig, amuam aam ameg waḏele anam amu deḏ amu, haen amu uḵe tueb batak a Nug ele ap̱a daap̱ig.
Aria nid aḏit Johanesnu nai dooya, Jesus dim lamidpiḏ ele, amunu oolahp̱a laip̱u laa nug onig Andreus, nug Simon Petrus ele, a am eamag.
Amu nug paha uḵa, Simon anṯa, nug amegp̱a aum. “I Mesias aaḵu anidmuḏ,” awa aum. Mesias diig amu danab laa Kayak Nug Nug wan imu ohnu oḵai daaḵunu epeḏiom. Grik naip̱a Mesias eḏuak amu Kristus.

Anam anana amu Andreus nug Simon omala, Jesus top̱a uḵom. Uḵe Jesus anṯa, amegp̱a aum. “Simon, Johanes beḵa, nahipnu ag geha Sipas aḵulag,” awa aum. Grik naip̱a Sipas eḏuak amu Petrus. Onig aḏit amu oh meu am men.
JESUS PILIPUS NATANIEL ELE ONILAHP̱A EUM

Waḵaḏe, deḏ amup̱a Jesus Nug Galelia goḵunu dab maama, Nug Pilipus, nug am Betsaida ted, nug Andreus Petrus ele, ag oh ap̱alag laip̱u amu, Jesus Nug nug maṯia anṯa amu nug amegp̱a aum. “Na da dim lamiḏe!” awa aum.

Anam a amu Pilipus nug Nataniel maṯia anṯa, amegp̱a aum. “Danab Moses nug anuḵa ḏo naip̱a nuhignu yom, propet ag ele nuhignu yaap̱ig amu ig aaḵu anidmut. Nug am Josep beḵa Jesus, Nasaret ted,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Nataniel nug aum. “Nasaret up̱anu amu keeke ena anam laa ii uḏima,” awa aum. A amu Pilipus nug aum. “Dona anṯe!” awa aum.
Pilipus nug anam a, Nataniel nug Jesus anidḵunu uḏieye, Jesus Nug anṯa, Nug aum. “Anṯeg! Umu am Israel ted genab. Nug oop̱a am ham bup̱uak laa iiṯa,” awa aum.

Anam a amu Nataniel Jesus oḏ meṯom. “Aṯemun na da dooiḏme?” awa oḏ meṯom. Nataniel anam a amu Jesus oḏep̱a awa aum. “Pilipus nug na oninp̱a eum, haen amu ii nak, da na ad onig pig waap̱a dayeye anidmi,” awa aum.
Jesus anam a amu Nataniel oḏep̱a awa aum. “Ip̱uniṯak danab, na am Kayak beḵa, na Israel dilag King,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Jesus Nug Nataniel oḏep̱a awa aum. “Da na ad pig waap̱a anidmi ami amunute na ootp̱a genab dooṯem? Na keeke amu eḏiṯak, laa ele geha anidḵut,” awa aum.
Jesus Nug anam anana, Nug nai baula ele tuḏiṯa aum. “Da genabnab genab ag amelagp̱a aṯem, geha hab obaṯeb, Kayaknu engel ag Danab Beḵalag da, da gumiḏna nenan tebep̱eg anadḵulag,” awa aum.
